description: Search RunAPI prompt examples by modality, category, tags, text query, or model. Free, no API key required.

modality.description: Prompt modality: image, video, music, or audio.

model.description: RunAPI model slug, for example flux-kontext-pro or suno-v5.

page.description: Page number; the API clamps values below 1 to 1.

per_page.description: Page size; the API clamps values to 1–100.

q.description: Text query matched against prompt title and prompt text.

tags.description: Tags to match. All provided tags must be present.

name: search_prompts
